---
name: speckit.specify
description: Generate feature specification with user stories and binary acceptance criteria
---
Generate the feature specification from product intent:
1. Define user stories and operational scope.
2. Define domain models, fields, and validation boundaries.
3. Formulate measurable, binary-testable acceptance criteria.
4. List assumptions, edge cases, and scope exclusions.
Save the output to `specs/smart-task-api/spec.md`.
